questions.question: Based on the given venn diagram, which of the following statement(s) is/are correct? I. Number of mango which are only fruit are 13. II. Number of potato which are neither fruit and nor mango are 5.
questions.questionHtml:
Based on the given venn diagram, which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

I. Number of mango which are only fruit are 13.

II. Number of potato which are neither fruit and nor mango are 5.
questions.solution:
Given:

I. Number of mango which are only fruit are 13 → True

The shaded part represents the number of mango which are only fruit.

So the number of mango which are only fruit are 13.

II. Number of potato which are neither fruit and nor mango are 5 → False

The shaded part represents the number of potato which are neither fruit and nor mango.

The number of potato which are neither fruit and nor mango are = 3

Hence, 'Only I’ statement is correct.
